```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv("HFR_soil-respiration_1991-2021.csv")

summary(raw_data)
head(raw_data)

```

```{r}
new_data <- raw_data %>%
  dplyr::select(year, treatment, plot, co2_flux) %>%
  filter(!is.na(co2_flux)) %>% 
  group_by(year, treatment, plot) %>%
  summarise(soil_res = mean(co2_flux)) 

new_data
write.csv(new_data, "HFR_soil-respiration_1991-2021_Processed.csv")
```
